label: Gross margin
short_definition: Gross profit as a share of revenue.
notes: TTM rows (ttm.py MARGIN_CONCEPTS) use gross_profit_resolved/revenue_sanity_resolved; the FY/quarter rows use revenue and cost_of_revenue. Frozen, reported as drift D3.

label: Operating margin
short_definition: Operating income as a share of revenue.
notes: TTM rows use operating_income_resolved/revenue_sanity_resolved; FY/quarter rows use operating_income/revenue. Drift D3.

label: Net margin
short_definition: Net income as a share of revenue.
notes: TTM rows use net_income_resolved/revenue_sanity_resolved; FY/quarter rows use net_income/revenue. Drift D3.

label: EBITDA
short_definition: Operating income plus depreciation and amortization.

label: Profitable-year streak
short_definition: Consecutive latest fiscal years with positive net income.
formula_description: Consecutive most-recent FY years with positive net income, counted backward from the latest year until a non-positive or missing year breaks the streak. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, one value as of the latest FY only (not a per-year series).
